Pages explicitly identify the recordings as CC0 and permit modification and
redistribution. Retrieved 2 October 2026. MP3 source previews were decoded to PCM.

Kenney, Impact Sounds (1.0), 19 December 2019:
https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
- impactSoft_medium_000 through 004.ogg
- footstep_grass_000 through 004.ogg
The pack's original License.txt is preserved in tools/audio_sources.

Edits: transient trimming, filtering, fades, gain matching and layering.
Original additions: resonant power/kick accents and the goal melody.
Processed game effects are in assets/*.wav; reproducible editing source and
render hashes are in tools/generate_audio.py and tools/audio_sources.
